# Walkthrough 02: Iteration 6 Master Verification & Execution

**Status**: Verified & Passing  
**Scope**: `apps/studio`, `packages/effect-engines`, `autogenerated-tests/`  

---

## 1. Executive Summary
Iteration 6 has successfully unified the **Canvas Direct Staging Layer**, **Deep Collapsible Inspector Panels**, **Library Drag-and-Drop Staging**, and **Partial Visual Effects Subsystem** into the Visual Storytelling Generator Studio (`apps/studio`).

By adhering to the design decision reached during the `/grill-me` alignment, the canvas viewport remains 100% clean and free of confusing 3D gizmos. 3D relighting vectors, camera spline matrices, particle physics, and audio DSP are cleanly managed through collapsible sidebar inspector panels with numeric inputs and visual sliders. Meanwhile, the canvas viewport is dedicated to direct 2D spatial layout, 8-handle transformation, magnetic snapping, inline text editing, and localized partial visual effects.

---

## 2. Completed Phase Deliverables

### Phase 1: In-Canvas 2D Vector Transform & Direct Staging Layer
- **`CanvasTransformOverlay` (`packages/effect-engines/src/three/CanvasTransformOverlay.ts`)**:
  - 8-point interactive bounding box handles (`tl`, `tc`, `tr`, `ml`, `mr`, `bl`, `bc`, `br`) and top rotation stem (`rotate`).
  - Scenegraph hierarchy managed in `UniversalThreeScene` with pure vector mathematics.
  - Headless export suppression via `setOverlayVisible(false)`.
- **`MagneticSnapEngine`**:
  - Automatic snapping to center crosshairs ($X=0.5, Y=0.5$) and 16:9 / 9:16 action/title safe zones ($5\%$ and $10\%$ margins).
  - Cyan dashed magnetic guidelines rendered dynamically during pointer drag.
- **`Preview.tsx` Direct Staging Integration**:
  - Live cursor coordinates and snapping badges displayed in the monitor bar.

### Phase 2: Deep Collapsible Inspector Panels & 3D Numeric Suite
- **Collapsible Accordions (`apps/studio/src/components/Sidebar.tsx`)**:
  - **3D Depth Relighting**: Blinn-Phong diffuse, specular, shininess exponent, rim intensity, light coordinates $(X, Y, Z)$, and 5 cinematography swatches (Cold Cyber Blue, Sunset Amber, Toxic Acid, Warm Tungsten, Neon Pink).
  - **3D Camera & Lens**: FOV ($15^\circ - 120^\circ$), camera roll angle, camera eye & target $(X, Y, Z)$, rack focus distance, focal range, and bokeh blur radius.
  - **Particle VFX & Shaders**: One-click presets (`cyber_sparks`, `cosmic_dust`, `matrix_rain`), SIMD particle physics (particle count $100 - 20,000$, gravity, drag, turbulence), and post-processing shaders (bloom threshold, chromatic aberration).
  - **Typography & Styling**: Font family, font size ($12 - 120\text{px}$), font weight ($300 - 900$), tracking, text color, and karaoke glow.
  - **Audio Dynamic Ducking & Pan**: Ducking volume ($0 - 100\%$), attack ($10 - 500\text{ms}$), release ($50 - 2000\text{ms}$), and stereo pan ($-1.0 \dots +1.0$).
- **Dual Controls & Reset**:
  - `ParameterSlider`: Paired slider + numeric `<Input>` field with double-click reset to defaults.
- **Modifier Removal with Undo**:
  - `RemoveModifierCommand`: Implemented undoable modifier removal wired into `IRStateManager`.

### Phase 3: Library Drag-and-Drop Staging, Inline Text Editing & Partial VFX
- **Presets Catalog (`apps/studio/src/lib/library/stagingPresets.ts`)**:
  - 12 production-grade presets across `text` (Cinematic Title, Cyberpunk Lower Third, Status Badge, HUD Callout Tag), `shape` (Rectangle, Frosted Glass Panel, Reticle Ring, Direction Arrow), and `vfx` (Regional Blur, Spotlight Relight, Regional Glitch, Point Particle Emitter).
- **Drag-and-Drop & Center Insert**:
  - HTML5 drag-and-drop onto canvas computes normalized $(X, Y)$ drop coordinates with visual drop boundary feedback.
  - Single-clicking "+ Insert" injects presets at viewport center $(0.5, 0.5)$.
  - Undoable track/sequence insertion via `AddSequenceCommand`.
- **Inline Canvas Text Editing**:
  - Double-clicking text overlays directly on canvas opens a floating editor with autofocus.
  - Commits edits to `VideoIR` via `UpdateTextCueCommand` on Enter or blur.
- **Three.js Partial VFX Subsystem (`UniversalThreeScene.ts`)**:
  - Renders spotlights (radial gradient with additive blending), point particle emitters, scanline glitches, and frosted blur panels.
  - Memory-safe lifecycle with zero leaks.

### Phase 4: Master Integration & End-to-End Test Suite
- Comprehensive automated verification across all 4 test suites:
  - `autogenerated-tests/studio_canvas_transform.test.ts` (5 tests)
  - `autogenerated-tests/studio_sidebar_inspector.test.ts` (5 tests)
  - `autogenerated-tests/studio_partial_vfx_staging.test.ts` (6 tests)
  - `autogenerated-tests/studio_iteration6_e2e.test.ts` (11 tests)
- Total: **27/27 tests passed in 56ms** with **242 assertions**.
- Production build: `bun run studio:build` succeeded in **3.68s**.
